key_insight: V-DUGKS reformulates continuum compressible flow simulation with vectorial distribution functions and separate momentum/energy relaxation, enabling adjustable Prandtl number and improved stability with compact velocity sets.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more efficient kinetic solver for compressible CFD, with larger stable time steps and lower sensitivity to numerical reference temperature than scalar DUGKS.
method: Uses a vectorial kinetic framework for mass, momentum, and total energy.
Truncates equilibrium distributions at second-order Hermite level and evaluates moments with fourth-order Gauss-Hermite quadrature.
Applies finite-volume discretization with characteristic-based fluxes and trapezoidal collision integration.
evidence_signal: Validated on shock-tube, Shu-Osher, 2D Riemann, and 3D Taylor-Green vortex cases, with reported 2.2–2.9× speed-up for the 3D Taylor-Green vortex under the same CFL constraint.
watch_item: Accuracy and stability depend on the chosen discrete velocity set and numerical reference temperature, so careful calibration is still needed for new flow regimes.
paper_title: Vectorial discrete unified gas kinetic scheme for continuum compressible flows
